text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion's name was trending on social 
media. It seemed she was currently 
livestreaming.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Greetings to everyone in Ireland. Today, I 
shall be sharing my training session with 
you all, desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
How I spend my days here in Japan—I shall 
show you everything without holding back.

text_block_list.name: Comment Section
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa!" "Lady Fine~~!" "We've been waiting 
for this!!" "Best stream ever!"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
To commemorate our very first stream, I 
have invited a special guest—Air 
Groove-san, please!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I am Air Groove, her roommate. We will now 
show you our joint training session.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
—Please pardon how intense this might 
look. First, 20 round-trips up the stairs!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Haaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Me too!! Haaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Comment Section
text_block_list.text:
"So fast...!" "Aren't they pushing too 
hard right away?" "They just started, you 
know?!"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... haa... phew. 20 sets... 
completed, desu wa!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Fine, it's too early to rest. We're 
running all the way back to the academy!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes, understood...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Ngh... g-guuugh...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Ugh, uuu...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...Haa... haa... Next, let us proceed.

text_block_list.name: Comment Section
text_block_list.text:
"She looks like she's in pain..." "That's 
way too hardcore!" "Lady Fine, please 
don't overdo it...!"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa... Ngh... haa... haa.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Now, this is the last one. A full-sprint 
lap around the track.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Are you sure this is wise? Isn't this 
stream meant to reassure the people back 
home?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, this is what I wanted them to see. 
Not a polished facade, but the real me 
right now.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I see... Then I won't hold back until the 
very end. Let's go.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
(Right now, seeing me struggle might make 
their hearts ache—)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
(Even so, I want them to experience it. 
The joy of having one's soul stirred by 
watching the one they support—)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
The burning happiness of watching me 
fight!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Haaaaahhhhh!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Comment Section
text_block_list.text:
"—She's so strong!" "So this is what she's 
really like?" "Incredible..." "This is our 
Lady Fine!"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Is that all you've got, Fine!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Not yet... Not yetttttt!!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I will not lose... I will never give up!!

text_block_list.name: Comment Section
text_block_list.text:
"Hang in there... You can do it!" 
"Gooooooo!!" "Lady Fiiine—!" "You are our 
absolute pride!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My fists clenched instinctively, and 
cheers escaped my lips in front of the 
screen. Surely everyone watching felt the 
exact same way.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Uwaaaaaaaahhhhh—!!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Phew. That concludes our stream. 
...Everyone, how was it, desu wa?

text_block_list.name: Comment Section
text_block_list.text:
"I'm so moved!" "You are so strong!" "I'm 
proud to have been born in the same 
country!" "We're cheering for you from 
across the ocean!"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
!! Is that so? Nothing could bring me 
greater joy. Truly—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I am deeply honored to have all of your 
support.
choice_data_list:
"The workout was so intense, it surprised 
me at first."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Seeing everyone fulfilled through my 
efforts brings me irreplaceable bliss, 
desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Once again, allow me to express my 
heartfelt gratitude—ufufufufu.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
In order to achieve victory in Japanese 
races, I shall strive forward with even 
greater dedication.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
And my wish is that you witness it with 
your own eyes: my proud, victorious figure 
at the end of all this hard work.
